sentence: No barbebisket forgives tailored swifts bought at the gas station.

wombos.definition: Barbecue brisket elevated to peak cookout status — the cinematic centerpiece of any serious barbecue spread.
wombos.example: He smoked it for twelve hours — that barbebisket was unreal.

wombos.definition: A thoughtful, personalized gift picked specifically for the recipient — the opposite of generic, one-size-fits-all giving.
wombos.example: Skip the average apparel and get her tailored swifts instead.
